Batch crawl where one seed URL returns 404 error

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::batch_crawl;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/good_seed"#, r#"https://example.com/bad_seed"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let result = batch_crawl(&engine, urls).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.completed_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.failed_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.total_count);
}
```
